scenes.title: The follow-up that begs is already dead.
scenes.body: Desperation is a smell. Clear next steps are a service. One good email beats three sad ones.
scenes.voice: The follow-up that begs is already dead. Desperation is a smell. Clear next steps are a service. One good email beats three sad ones that apologize for existing.

scenes.title: Assume they are busy, not cruel.
scenes.body: Your job is to make the next decision easy. Not to perform emotional labor for their inbox.
scenes.voice: Rule one. Assume they are busy, not cruel. Your job is to make the next decision easy, not to perform emotional labor for their inbox.

scenes.title: The 48-hour nudge.
scenes.body: Subject: quick follow-up on [specific thing] • Body: one sentence reminder + one clear question + soft out.
scenes.voice: Script one. The forty eight hour nudge. Subject line names the specific thing. Body is one sentence reminder, one clear question, and a soft out. No 'just checking in' without a reason.

scenes.title: The value-add bump.
scenes.body: Add one new useful scrap: a link, a sentence of insight, a corrected detail. Never pure 'any update?'
scenes.voice: Script two. The value-add bump. You give them one new useful scrap. A link, a sentence of insight, a corrected detail. Pure 'any update' is just noise with manners.

scenes.title: The close-the-loop final.
scenes.body: I am closing my file on this unless I hear otherwise. Still happy to help if the timing changes.
scenes.voice: Script three. The close-the-loop final. I am closing my file on this unless I hear otherwise. Still happy to help if the timing changes. Dignity intact. Inbox free.

scenes.title: When to send (and stop).
scenes.body: Day 2-3 first. Day 7 second. Day 14 final. Then stop. Silence is also data.
scenes.voice: Timing. First follow-up day two or three. Second around day seven. Final around day fourteen. Then stop. Silence is also data. Do not become a recurring notification.

scenes.title: Read it out loud. Cringe test.
scenes.body: If it sounds like you need them more than they need the result, rewrite. Helpful > hungry.
scenes.voice: Tone check. Read it out loud. If it sounds like you need them more than they need the result, rewrite. Helpful beats hungry every single time.

scenes.title: Copy the scripts. Customize three fields.
scenes.body: Specific subject. Specific prior conversation. Specific ask. Then send and close the tab.
scenes.voice: Your next move. Copy the three scripts. Customize the subject, the prior conversation, and the specific ask. Send one. Close the tab. The empire of unread emails can wait.

scenes.title: Follow-ups that beg die alone.
scenes.body: Clear next step > emotional apology tour.
scenes.voice: Follow-ups that beg die alone in the inbox. Clear next step beats the emotional apology tour.

scenes.body: Day 2, day 7, day 14. Then silence is data.
